name: Vietnam
change_summary: December 2025 law: SI 8%/17.5% and HI 1.5%/3% on the 20 × 2,340,000 = 46,800,000 cap; unemployment insurance 1%/1% on 20 regional minimum wages (Region I 4,960,000); the 2% union fee; and the seven-rung PIT scale with the Resolution 954/2020 deductions of 132,000,000 and 52,800,000.

work_rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.98(1)(a) — overtime pay on a normal working day shall be at least 150% of the wage per unit of the work performed during normal working hours; Bộ luật Lao động 2019 (Luật số 45/2019/QH14, thông qua 20/11/2019) có hiệu lực thi hành từ ngày 01/01/2021 (Điều 220(1))

vanban.chinhphu.vn — the Government document database. /?pageid=27160&docid=<id> is an instrument page (number, dates, effective date) and links its text at datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/<yyyy>/<mm>/<file>.pdf. name: Vietnam — 1 January 2026
change_summary: From the 2026 tax period: the five-rung PIT table of Law 109/2025 (art.29(2)) with Resolution 110/2025’s 186,000,000/74,400,000 deductions; Decree 293/2025 raises regional minimum wages 7.2%; Law 74/2025 replaces the Law on Employment.

work_rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.98(1)(a) — overtime pay on a normal working day shall be at least 150% of the wage per unit of the work performed during normal working hours; Bộ luật Lao động 2019 (Luật số 45/2019/QH14, thông qua 20/11/2019) có hiệu lực thi hành từ ngày 01/01/2021 (Điều 220(1))

name: Vietnam — 1 July 2026
change_summary: Decree 161/2026 raises the reference level to 2,530,000, so the SI/HI/union-fee cap becomes 50,600,000; Decree 253/2026 implements the PIT law, including the overtime and night-pay exemption (Law 109/2025 art.4(8): the whole overtime wage, so the OVERTIME bands carry no PIT opt-in); the Law on Population 113/2025 gives a second child 7 months’ maternity and 10 days’ paternity; Nghị quyết 28/2026 adds 24 November as a paid holiday.

work_rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.98(1)(a) — overtime pay on a normal working day shall be at least 150% of the wage per unit of the work performed during normal working hours; Bộ luật Lao động 2019 (Luật số 45/2019/QH14, thông qua 20/11/2019) có hiệu lực thi hành từ ngày 01/01/2021 (Điều 220(1))
